messages:
anaya: Heads up — we need runtime + infra inputs for the new token-cost dashboard. Goal: show cost/1k tokens + cache/batch savings waterfall by route/model/tenant. Can teams confirm metrics/labels we can rely on? cc @leo @samir @eva :eyes:

leo: We can emit KV cache metrics: redwood_cache_hits_total, redwood_cache_misses_total, redwood_cache_bytes_saved_total. Also batch stats: redwood_batch_size_histogram, redwood_continuous_batch_latency_ms. Labels: model, route, region, tenant_hash (avoid raw tenant IDs).

samir: +1 on tenant_hash. Also need per-request token counters: tokens_in_total, tokens_out_total. Tokenizer differences matter — include tokenizer_family label when available.

eva: Console UX asks for three main views: 1) timeseries: cost / 1k tokens, 2) waterfall: baseline cost -> cache savings -> batching savings -> quantization delta, 3) per-tenant drilldown. For the waterfall we need either total_cost or the inputs to compute cost. Can billing expose cost_per_token by model_variant?

leo: We can surface model_variant metadata metric for join: redwood_model_variant_info{variant="gptx-8q", param_count="6.2e9"} 1. Recommend adding model_variant and model_size labels so ETL can map to USD. Runtime shouldn't calculate USD.

maya: For clean joins, include these fields in a small request-summary event to Kafka: request_id, trace_id, timestamp, tenant_hash, route, model_variant, tokenizer_family, tokens_in, tokens_out, batch_id, cache_hit. No PII. We'll publish to topic telemetry.request-summary.

samir: For routing/quota attribution: when a request is routed to a fallback/cheaper variant, we still need to attribute cost to the original logical route. Add routed_from_route and routed_from_variant labels to the summary event.

anaya: Good call. Also need cache attribution: add cache_key_type (prefix|kv|prompt_cache) and cache_hit boolean.

platform-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-producer v2.4.1 deployed to prod in us-west-2 :rocket:

leo: PromQL snippet for cache hit rate (example to use in dashboards):
```
sum by(route,model) (rate(redwood_cache_hits_total[5m])) / (sum by(route,model) (rate(redwood_cache_hits_total[5m])) + sum by(route,model) (rate(redwood_cache_misses_total[5m])))
```

eva: For cost/1k tokens UI: we'll compute cost_per_1k = (total_cost_usd / tokens_total) * 1000. If runtime can't provide USD, runtime should provide gpu_seconds or inferred_cpu_gpu_time and ETL will map to USD using unit rates. Also want a stacked area showing savings over time (cache vs batching).

anaya: Action items:
- leo / infra: publish metric names + exact label sets + example events to telemetry.request-summary (deadline: Thu EOD)
- maya: publish schema for telemetry.request-summary + kafka topic + retention (Thu)
- billing: add model_variant unit cost mapping in ETL (product/billing sync)
- product/eva: mock dashboard visuals and waterfall compute (Fri)
- eng-platform/samir: update routing layer to emit routed_from_* labels on fallback (Thu)

I'll open a GH issue linking these items and draft the ingestion contract. Thanks everyone! :pray:
